meta.title: Unit 1 – Office Life – Part 3 (sample)
meta.notes_vi: Hội thoại mẫu 2 người, có 1 câu hỏi hàm ý.

directions.speaker: NARRATOR
directions.text: Part 3. Directions: You will hear some conversations between two or more people. You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speakers say in each conversation. Select the best response to each question and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet. The conversations will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation.

segments.speaker: W
segments.text: Hi Daniel, do you have a minute?
segments.dictation_text: Hi Daniel, do you have a minute?

segments.speaker: W
segments.text: The client from Harlow Logistics just called about tomorrow's meeting.
segments.dictation_text: The client from Harlow Logistics just called about tomorrow's meeting.

segments.speaker: W
segments.text: Their flight was canceled, so they can't get here until Thursday afternoon.
segments.dictation_text: Their flight was canceled, so they can't get here until Thursday afternoon.

segments.speaker: W
segments.text: They're asking if we can move it to Friday morning.
segments.dictation_text: They're asking if we can move it to Friday morning.

segments.speaker: M
segments.text: Friday morning? The sales team has its training session then.
segments.dictation_text: Friday morning? The sales team has its training session then.

segments.speaker: W
segments.text: Right, but the session only needs the junior staff.
segments.dictation_text: Right, but the session only needs the junior staff.

segments.speaker: W
segments.text: You and I could still meet the client in the small conference room.
segments.dictation_text: You and I could still meet the client in the small conference room.

segments.speaker: M
segments.text: I'll book the room and send them an updated invitation.
segments.dictation_text: I'll book the room and send them an updated invitation.

segment.speaker: NARRATOR
segment.text: Number thirty-two. Why does the client want to change the meeting?
segment.dictation_text: Why does the client want to change the meeting?

questions.printed_question: Why does the client want to change the meeting?
questions.explanation_vi: "Their flight was canceled" được paraphrase thành "A trip has been disrupted". A dùng lại ý conference room nhưng sai.

segment.speaker: NARRATOR
segment.text: Number thirty-three. What does the woman imply when she says, Right, but the session only needs the junior staff?
segment.dictation_text: What does the woman imply when she says, Right, but the session only needs the junior staff?

questions.printed_question: What does the woman imply when she says, "Right, but the session only needs the junior staff"?

options.B: She will lead the session herself.
options.C: The speakers are free to attend the meeting.
options.D: More junior staff should be hired.

questions.explanation_vi: Người nữ ngụ ý hai người không phải dự training nên vẫn gặp khách được. B, D dùng lại từ session, junior staff.

segment.speaker: NARRATOR
segment.text: Number thirty-four. What will the man do next?
segment.dictation_text: What will the man do next?

questions.printed_question: What will the man do next?
questions.explanation_vi: "I'll book the room" = Reserve a meeting space.
